|translation='''Title:''' Hyper Escape.

'''Card text:''' Use when a battle is declared at a system. If you can move all of your starships away, using Force as usual, the battle is canceled.

'''Lore:''' “We'll be safe enough once we jump to hyperspace.” Unless a beacon is planted, there is no way to track a starship that has entered hyperspace.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese cancels the battle if you can move all your starships away; the English cancels by moving them away.
